title: Andhra Pradesh Targets ₹9.5 Lakh Crore Investment in Visakhapatnam Region
summary: The Andhra Pradesh government has set an investment target of up to ₹9.5 lakh crore for the Visakhapatnam Economic Region (VER). The plan covers eight districts and spans 36,000 sq km in north coastal Andhra Pradesh and adjoining areas....

blocks.content: The Andhra Pradesh government has set an investment target of up to ₹9.5 lakh crore for the Visakhapatnam Economic Region (VER). The plan covers eight districts and spans 36,000 sq km in north coastal Andhra Pradesh and adjoining areas.

items: Visakhapatnam is a major port city on the east coast of India in Andhra Pradesh.
The Visakhapatnam Economic Region covers eight districts and a total area of 36,000 sq km.
The Confederation of Indian Industry is one of India’s major industry bodies and organises the CII Partnership Summit.
The 31st CII Partnership Summit is scheduled in Visakhapatnam from November 12 to 13, 2026.
